column1: # Fitness determinants of Pseudomonas aeruginosa UCBPP-PA14 during energy-limited growth arrest: transposon mutants with a fitness defect after 10 days of carbon limitation or oxygen limitation followed by aerobic outgrowth

# Basta DW, Bergkessel M, Newman DK. 2017. Identification of fitness determinants during energy-limited growth arrest in Pseudomonas aeruginosa. mBio 8(6):e01170-17. https://doi.org/10.1128/mBio.01170-17

# Source: Data Set S1 (mbo006173591sd1.xlsx, sheet "Carbon limited") and Data Set S2 (mbo006173591sd2.xlsx, sheet "Oxygen limited") (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC5705914/supplementaryFiles)

# Cutoff: the paper's own criterion, geometric mean read ratio of the two replicates < 0.25 and combined P < 0.05 (Fisher); 24 genes pass under carbon limitation and 42 under oxygen limitation, 62 distinct genes in the union (intergenic regions excluded)
# Licensed CC BY 4.0; values as published

# Columns: locus_tag = PA14 locus tag as published; gene = UniProt primary gene name for that tag; uniprot = the PAO1 protein in the species index, by blastp best hit of the PA14 protein against the index (>= 90% identity and >= 90% coverage of both sequences); mean_read_ratio = geometric mean of the replicate read ratios; fisher_p = combined P value; condition = the screen the gene passed in
